title: Temporary Transferability of Season Parking between Car Parks with EV Chargers and Those Without
what_it_is: Temporary Transferability of Season Parking between Car Parks with EV Chargers and Those Without

sections.label: HDB EV season parking transfer
sections.summary: HDB lets residents temporarily transfer season parking to another car park with EV chargers at the same rate, with no plans for one ticket covering two car parks.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: To support the charging needs of residents with EVs, HDB allows residents to temporarily transfer their existing season parking to another car park with EV chargers at the same season parking rate.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Currently, there are no plans to allow EV owners to hold one season parking ticket that allows season parking at two different car parks.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: While we support the charging needs of residents with EVs, we also have to be fair to other season parking holders who are not EV owners.

sections.label: MP appeals for EV charging
sections.summary: Residents who write to their Members of Parliament about EV charging at a different car park will be offered season parking there at the same rate.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: For residents who write in to their Members of Parliament about having access to EV charging at a different car park, we will offer to provide season parking at the other car park at the same season parking rate.

sections.label: HDB EV charging fairness review
sections.summary: HDB will review EV support with the Ministry of Transport while ensuring fairness to non-EV owners, with about nine in 10 HDB car parks having EV charging by end of 2025.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: While we support the adoption of EVs and incentives are there to support EV owners, we also want to make sure that it is fair and consistent to those who are not having EVs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: This is something we will continue to review with our colleagues at the Ministry of Transport (MOT), but I want to just reiterate that the intent is to ensure that HDB car parks serve the residents who live in the area and to be fair to them.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: That means that almost 2,000 HDB car parks – that is about nine in 10 HDB car parks – will have EV charging facilities by end of 2025.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: Fast chargers will be installed at 38 car parks located within a town and neighbourhood centres.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: This is really the context, which I hope Members can appreciate.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: We are doing as much as we can to provide charging facilities to all EV owners living in HDB estates.
